name: Mothers
overview: Scripture highlights the sacred role of mothers in nurturing and instructing their children, emphasizing honor toward both father and mother as a foundation for a long and blessed life (Exodus 20:12). Children are portrayed as a divine heritage and reward, underscoring the value of motherhood (Psalms 127:3). The wisdom imparted by mothers is to be cherished and not forsaken, as seen in the repeated exhortations to heed a mother's instruction alongside a father's commands (Proverbs 1:8; 6:20). Moreover, the responsibility to train children in the right way, promising lasting impact, and the respect due to mothers even in their old age, further affirm the enduring importance of the mother-child relationship (Proverbs 22:6; 23:22).
